snippet.title: Which Is The Smartest Secondary School In Singapore? | National STEM Championship 2026 EP 1
snippet.description:
Every school thinks it's the smartest. Today, we find out who can actually prove it.

The National STEM Championship (NSTEMC) 2026 is here. 
In Episode 1, student teams from across Singapore take on their first STEM challenges with one goal: don't get cut. Not everyone makes it to the next round, and there's only one way to find out who does.

Hosted by MJ Biogirl.

Chapters
00:00 Intro
00:34 Meet the students
01:09 How the challenges work
01:29 Challenge 1: Sea Jelly Fields
04:19 Challenge 2: Crossroad Caverns
07:05 Challenge 3: Octopus Lair
10:19 Challenge 4: Rocky Isle
12:47 Who makes the cut?
13:30 The real game starts now

Watch the full series: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSTw9nVnMpnI&si=cRCPcWL1fNddYtkZ

About the National STEM Championship (NSTEMC): a national competition from Science Centre Singapore that challenges students to think like scientists and engineers. In this series, schools take on partner-led challenges, play power cards on each other and chase one title.
